message:
README: chapter 2 levels

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Chibi castle towers, dwarf mortar artillery, chapter 2 with six new maps, sharper characters

- All 16 towers rebuilt as chibi castles: bulged stone keeps, oversized spires with gold
  finials, crest banners; front parapets drawn over the units standing on top
- Dwarf tower becomes long-range splash artillery (mortar), slower than archers, cluster shells at tier 4
- Chapter 2: six new layouts (multi-entrance, new rivers and lakes), tuned with the balance bot;
  campaign map extends to the right
- Character frames rendered at the next-larger resolution (cap 4x), and auto quality
  recovers when the game runs smoothly; old saved low-quality settings reset

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Shrink the shared WebGL buffer after the terrain render (3D frames 18.6 ms -> 3.6 ms)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Upgrade screen with large 3D towers; README covers the graphics overhaul

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Hair, beard and cloth materials; 3D gear icons on the hero screen

- New in-shader hair (strands + glossy ring), fur and cloth patterns for all characters
- Weapon, glove, armor and boot gear shown as tinted 3D objects per tier

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Tower cast shadows and a Kingdom Rush style battle HUD

- Towers project a shadow silhouette along the same sun direction as map props
- Stat bars become gold-trimmed wooden plaques with large 3D icons
- Skill buttons get metal rims, glass highlight and a 3D sun icon
- Hero portrait framed wider so the whole head shows

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Procedural 3D materials, real cast shadows and 3D ground detail

- Toon shader patch: brick, stone, flagstone, wood, roof tile, leaf, rock, bark,
  plaster, straw, cactus and cloth patterns generated in-shader (no textures),
  plus regional rim light, metal glints and contact darkening
- Map props now live in the terrain scene and cast real shadow-mapped shadows
- Grass tufts, flowers, pebbles, kerb stones and road slabs are instanced 3D
- Gentle terrain relief with soft slope lighting; sharper battle background

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Dynamic lighting for Volcano and Chaos maps; README covers the full 3D pass

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Regional battle music and ambient soundscapes (birds, bells, desert and ice wind, lava rumble, void drone)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

3D object icons for the UI (coin, star, heart, skull, crown, chest, weapons...), cached in localStorage

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

8-direction 3D facing: tower units aim at targets, units and enemies turn along their movement

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Animated water: drifting river glints, lake ripples, bubbling lava

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

3D terrain: carved river and lava beds, sunken roads, 3D bridges

js/terrain3d.js builds a ground mesh textured with the hand-painted ground, carves water
and lava beds (stamped distance field, sloped banks), sinks the road slightly, shades
slopes in toon steps with the scene sun, lays a translucent water plane and builds wooden
or stone 3D bridges where paths cross water. It renders once per level in tiles of at most
2048 px using the shared WebGL renderer.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Performance: buffer reuse, lower in-battle detail, idle prewarm, adaptive resolution

- art3d renders every model into a viewport of one grow-only WebGL buffer instead of
  resizing (reallocating) it for each frame size
- chars3d gains a detail level; battle builds use 0.62 of the studio polygon counts
- level enemy and hero frames are prewarmed in 6 ms slices after the level starts
- device pixel ratio is capped at 2 and automatically lowered (remembered) when frames
  average above 24 ms; Painter frame resolution is capped accordingly
Average 3D frame cost in the test run dropped from ~5.5 ms to ~3.7 ms.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Per-region 3D lighting and docs

Each level sets a lighting preset (warm lava, cool ice, violet chaos, sunny desert) for the
3D renderer before the map is built; frame, flag and prop caches are keyed or cleared by
the active preset. README lists the 3D map, effects and lighting.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

3D projectiles, meteors and waving flags

- js/fx3d.js: arrow (ally / enemy / piercing), magic shard, bomb and meteor rock models
  snapshotted per resolution and rotated in flight; trails and glows stay as effects
- 3D cloth flags with 8 baked wave frames replace the tower, spawn and defend flags

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

3D campaign world map and fresh level thumbnails

The campaign map now blends six region grounds and scatters each region's 3D props plus
landmarks (castle, desert fort and obelisk, ice castle, lava altar, void portal), keeping
clear of the level nodes and route. Level thumbnails map_N.jpg are re-rendered from the
3D-prop battle maps.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

3D map props: trees, rocks, buildings, castle gates and monuments

- design/props3d.js models all 23 decor kinds (per-theme colours) and the 11 big map
  structures (gate castle, fort, monuments per theme, houses, tents, ruins, mesa, well,
  gateway, void portal)
- js/map3d.js snapshots each model/theme/variant once into a sprite and places it in
  depth order on the hand-painted ground; mapart.js falls back to 2D when 3D is off
- Art3D.sprite renders any static model to a cropped canvas

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

3D death animations, tower GLBs and docs

- Painter gains a 'die' frame mode; with 3D on, corpses play each model's die clip
  instead of tipping over the idle frame
- drake death no longer sinks below its frame
- all 34 characters and the 4 tower types re-exported to assets/models
- README describes the fully 3D battlefield

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

3D towers and build plots on the battlefield

- design/towers3d.js: elf, mage, barracks and dwarf hall towers in 4 tiers plus the empty
  build plot, built with the chars3d kit; platform heights match the 2D character spots
- art3d.js renders tower statics and plots from these models (flags, fire, doors and
  units on top still come from the animated fx layer)
- towers appear in the 3D studio under "Cong trinh" (static models)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

3D models for all remaining enemies

Adds 20 enemies to chars3d.js (orc archer, warg, treant, skeleton, wraith, death knight,
bandit, mummy, scorpion, frost wolf, ice golem, imp, drake, magma golem, voidling,
void walker, black orc, troll, troll king, void lord) with their own rigs and clips
(scorpion and drake rigs, wing/tail motion hook, punch and zombie poses). The battlefield
now draws every enemy from its 3D model; GLBs exported to assets/models.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Battlefield characters rendered from the 3D models

- js/art3d.js renders every walk/attack/idle frame (side, back, front views) of the
  3D chibi models via an offscreen WebGL renderer into Painter's frame cache; meshes are
  merged per joint+material to keep draw calls low
- covers the 4 towers (all tiers), heroes (by gear), goblin, shade, orc, wolf rider,
  dark knight and dark lord phases; sizes matched to the old 2D art, thicker ink in battle
- Settings toggle "Nhan vat 3D" (falls back to 2D, also automatic without WebGL)
- three.js + chars3d.js added to the offline cache (krv10)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

3D character studio: chibi toon models with outlines, animations and GLB/sprite export

- design/chars3d.js builds 14 characters in 3D from the chibi.js designs (4 towers x 4 tiers,
  4 heroes, goblin, shade, orc variants, wolf rider, dark knight and dark lord phases) with
  named joints and baked idle/walk/attack/skill/die clips
- design/nhan-vat-3d.html studio: orbit view, tiers, animations, palette, 4-view turnaround,
  GLB export, 8-direction sprite sheet export
- prebuilt assets/models/*.glb; codex gets a "Mo hinh 3D" tab

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Redesign roster per spec: 4 player towers, orcs become enemies, new chibi characters and bosses

- Towers: Human (2 swordsmen, horizontal slash, planted-sword idle, tier-4 shield wall), Elf (fast, crit glowing arrows, tier-4 triple shot),
  Mage (longest range, AoE magic circle, tier-4 meteor), Dwarf hall (1 fat two-handed-axe dwarf, ground slam stun, beard-stroke idle)
- Orc tower removed; orcs are enemies. New enemies: chibi Goblin (hunched, looks around, stab, rolling death), Orc Wolf Rider (charge + ram),
  Shade minions, Dark Knight mid-boss (summons shades, phase 2 red blade + rising cape), Dark Lord final boss (3 phases)
- Units step back when hit; codex shows chibi tiers and poses; red-themed Human tower, new Dwarf hall art

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

KR-like feel: smaller bouncy units, wider light roads, open layout with lamps and plaza monument, comic hit words

- Characters drawn at 0.72 scale with KR proportions (smaller head, longer legs, smaller eyes)
- New motion: bounce + squash/stretch on steps, knee lift, arm swing, lagging head bob, big anticipation/lunge attacks; generic squash for legacy enemies; more frames
- Road width 62 -> 88, light road palette with dark grass lip, cobble patches; enemies spread across the road
- Layout: open play area, dense frame at edges, lamp posts along roads, plaza with themed monument
- Comic words (POW!, KAPOW!, BOOM!, BONK!...) on hits and explosions
- Final level waves 6-7 slightly eased

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Code-drawn Kingdom Rush style battlefields replacing illustration backgrounds

- New js/mapart.js: textured ground, dirt roads with ruts/pebbles or cobblestone, edge stones and grass,
  rivers/lakes with banks, glowing lava, frozen lakes, auto bridges, dense KR-style trees and props,
  gate castles/forts/portal at path ends, floating islands for the chaos map
- Layout (paths, rivers, landmarks) follows the user's map designs (maps-img.js FEAT)
- Level thumbnails regenerated from the coded maps

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Chibi heroes (Aldric, Lyra, Selene, Borin) with gear-driven looks, sharper level thumbnails

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Kingdom Rush style: chibi tower characters, redrawn towers, AI-upscaled sharp maps

- New js/chibi.js: the 5 characters redrawn as KR-style chibi (big head, thick ink), 4 tiers, walk/attack/bow/staff anims, back view
- art-towers.js rewritten: chunky stone/wood towers with bricks, tiled cone roofs, lit windows, banners, flags; 4 distinct tiers each
- Battle maps re-cut and upscaled with Real-ESRGAN x4plus for crisp detail
- Thicker dark outlines on enemies and heroes to match

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Soldiers use front/side/back art views by walking direction

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Ground decals, tower rise animation, build spots avoid water/lava/void in map art

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Real map art as battlefield, orc den spawns orc warriors, KR-style animations and spells

- Battle maps now use the user's map artwork (battle_N.jpg cut from maps.png); paths traced along the drawn roads, world width follows image aspect
- Orc tower becomes a barracks-type den that spawns 3 orc warriors (stun every 3rd hit at tier 4)
- Sprite animation: step bounce/squash, wind-up + lunge + slash smear, ranged charge glow, white hit flash, corpses fall and fade
- Two global spells: Reinforcements and Meteor Shower
- Rebalance final level for shorter real-map paths

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Balance: smooth Volcano difficulty spike, make final Chaos Gate level harder

- Volcano: move Magma Golem from wave 2 to wave 3, add a wave, lighter boss escort, Troll King HP 5950 -> 5200
- Chaos Gate: start gold 820 -> 760, bigger late waves and boss escort

Use real anime character art for the 5 tower characters + map previews
